paras: A centre table, also called a coffee table, brings the living room together. Ours starts at 100 × 55 cm with a height of 45 cm, which is a comfortable reach from a sofa.

We can make it round or rectangular, add a lower shelf, and match the finish to your sofa set and TV unit. Tell us the size of your seating area and we will suggest a size that leaves enough room to walk around it.
faq: Can you make a round centre table?
Yes. Tell us the diameter you want and the height, and we will quote it.
Can it match my sofa set?
Yes. Send us a photo of the sofa set and we will match the wood tone or finish where we can.
